+# zero pose. This is used to turn wrist RGB-D pixels into base-frame points.
+_axes = np.asarray(spec['arm']['axis'], dtype=float)
+_joint0 = np.asarray(spec['arm']['position_m'], dtype=float)
+_ee0 = np.asarray(spec['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'], dtype=float)
+_lengths = np.r_[np.diff(_joint0[:, 2]), _ee0[2] - _joint0[-1, 2]]
+_cam0 = np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['position_m'], dtype=float)
+_cam_R0 = np.column_stack([
+    np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['right'], dtype=float),
+    -np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['up'], dtype=float),
+    np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['forward'], dtype=float),
+])
+_ee_cam_offset = _ee0 - _cam0
+
+
+def rot_axis(axis, angle):
+    axis = np.asarray(axis, dtype=float)
+    axis = axis / np.linalg.norm(axis)
+    x, y, z = axis
+    c, s = np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)
+    C = 1.0 - c
+    return np.array([
+        [c + x*x*C, x*y*C - z*s, x*z*C + y*s],
+        [y*x*C + z*s, c + y*y*C, y*z*C - x*s],
+        [z*x*C - y*s, z*y*C + x*s, c + z*z*C],
+    ])
+
+
+def fk(q):
+    """Return (grasp point, camera origin, camera [right, down, forward])."""
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    p = _joint0[0].copy()
+    R = np.eye(3)
+    for i in range(7):
+        R = R @ rot_axis(_axes[i], q[i])
+        if i < 6:
+            p = p + R @ np.array([0.0, 0.0, _lengths[i]])
+    ee = p + R @ np.array([0.0, 0.0, _lengths[6]])
+    cam = ee - R @ _ee_cam_offset
+    cam_R = R @ _cam_R0
+    return ee, cam, cam_R
+
+
+def wrist_pixel_to_base(q, base_xyz, u, v, depth):
+    """Project one wrist RGB-D pixel to the odometry frame."""
+    camspec = spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']
+    h, w = camspec['hw']
+    fy = h / (2.0 * np.tan(np.deg2rad(camspec['fovy_deg']) / 2.0))
+    fx = fy
+    cam_R = fk(q)[2]
+    p_cam = fk(q)[1]
+    pt_cam = np.array([(u - w/2) * depth / fx,
+                       (v - h/2) * depth / fy,
+                       depth])
+    return np.asarray(base_xyz) + p_cam + cam_R @ pt_cam

+    """Finite-difference position Jacobian of the grasp point."""
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    p0 = fk(q)[0]
+    J = np.zeros((3, 7))

+        q1[i] += eps
